<!--
Template for answering one question with BACI.
Copy this file, rename it, and change only the three marked blocks.
It assumes the loader has run once (Rscript loaders/baci.R <snapshot>), so the
data are already Parquet. Nothing here reads the raw CSVs.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")  # paths below are relative to the repository root
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

```{r data}
# A "lazy" handle on all BACI years: nothing is loaded into memory yet.
# dplyr verbs are translated and only run when you call collect().
baci      <- open_dataset("data/baci")
countries <- read_parquet("data/baci_meta/countries.parquet")
```

```{r choices}
# ── CHANGE 1: HS revision and years ─────────────────────────────────────────
hs    <- 92            # 92 for long series (1995-), 22 for modern products (2022-)
years <- 2000:2024

# ── CHANGE 2: products (HS6 codes, as text) ─────────────────────────────────
# Leave NULL for all products. Look codes up in reference/hs/ rather than guessing.
products <- NULL       # e.g. c("260500", "810520") for cobalt ore and mattes (HS22)

# ── CHANGE 3: country groups, by atlas_iso3 ─────────────────────────────────
# Define groups with ISO3, never with countrycode(..., "iso3n"): BACI's
# numeric codes differ for France, USA, India, Norway and Switzerland.
groups <- tribble(
  ~atlas_iso3, ~group,
  "CHN", "China",
  "USA", "United States",
  "DEU", "European Union", "FRA", "European Union", "ITA", "European Union"
  # ... everyone not listed becomes "Others"
)

# Code -> group lookup. Sudan's pre-2012 code (736) is included automatically,
# because the join is on ISO3 rather than on the numeric code.
code_group <- countries |>
  left_join(groups, by = "atlas_iso3") |>
  mutate(group = coalesce(group, "Others")) |>
  select(country_code, group)
```

```{r query}
query <- baci |> filter(hs_rev == hs, t %in% years)
if (!is.null(products)) query <- query |> filter(k %in% products)

result <- query |>
  collect() |>                                         # data enter memory here
  left_join(code_group, by = c("i" = "country_code")) |> rename(exporter = group) |>
  left_join(code_group, by = c("j" = "country_code")) |> rename(importer = group) |>
  group_by(t, exporter, importer) |>
  summarise(
    value_usd_bn = sum(v) / 1e6,          # v is thousands of USD -> billions
    tonnes       = sum(q, na.rm = TRUE),  # only meaningful if `products` is one product
    .groups = "drop"
  )

result
```

```{r save}
# One output file per question, named after the chart id it will feed.
dir.create("data/working", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(result, "data/working/<chart-id>.csv")
```

**Before using the result, check:**
- Is the latest year (provisional) flagged?
- Does any group include an entrepôt (Hong Kong, Singapore, Netherlands, UAE)?
- Were the product codes chosen in the same HS revision as `hs`?
